svg.title: One queen and the three flags it sets
svg.desc: An 8 by 8 board with a queen on row 2, column 4, its row, column and both diagonals shaded, and the three constraint arrays below with col_used index 4, diag_sum_used index 6 and diag_diff_used index 5 set.
svg.text: A test is one ld a, (hl) and one or a. unmark_constraints writes those three bytes back to zero on the way out.
